title: Telco US
description: US mobile operator for the Teneo best-practice showcase: authentication, plan switch, bill explanation, outages by ZIP, device troubleshooting, store finder and repair bookings. American customers.
notes:
Brand-neutral on purpose: plan names (Essential, Plus, Unlimited, Family Share, Business Pro) carry no company name, so the Teneo solution can set the company and bot name in global variables. Phone numbers use the 555-01xx range (reserved for fiction), emails use example.com. Customer numbers are TN- plus 8 digits; PINs are stored in plain text because this is demo data only.

Catalogue: plans (P-ESS, P-PLUS, P-UNL, P-FAM, P-BIZ; P-BIZ only for segment business) and addons (data, roaming passes by zone 1/2/3, international calling, device protection). Stores carry latitude/longitude for the nearest-store tool; repair_center says whether repairs can be booked there. Dates are relative to the day the dataset is loaded, so reset it before a demo.
